title: Ecgberht Strip (instrument heartbeat)
description: Typed Strip fields for portfolio rank and dispatch. Machine append-only instruments/receipts. Aligns with the campaign v0 strip.json (ecgberht-strip-v0). Heal law: Strip wins append-only clocks; reject silent in-place clock rewrite; crisis heal = explicit re-sync append only; capacity=unknown is rank penalty + LITE bias (never silent green).

active_effort.description: Active effort id or short label

human_wait.description: What is waiting on a human, or 'none'

capacity.description: AI/subscription capacity signal; unknown is stricter than zero (rank penalty + LITE bias)

negative_heartbeat.description: Explicit no-attention-needed signal (silence is not truth)

anti_starvation_age_days.description: Anti-starvation age in days for strip-first rank boost

instruments.description: Append-only instrument history; prior entries must never be rewritten in place

receipts.description: Append-only receipt history; prior entries must never be rewritten in place

grasscatch.description: Parked ideas / deferred scopes (Strip instrument, not Face narrative)

tool_depth_cell.description: Dispatch/table depth cell (LITE|FULL|SPIKE|commission|refuse or named cell)

why_next.description: Why that next action ranks first
